articles.title: Korda produces 'special' second round to recover from day one woes
articles.summary: World number one Nelly Korda returns to form on day two of the Women's Open, carding three-under-par 68 to erase her opening round struggles. Her bounce-back leaves her one under par total and just five shots behind leader Haeran Ryu, setting up an exciting weekend chase at Royal Lytham & St. Annes Golf Course.

World number one Nelly Korda returns to form on day two of the Women's Open, carding three-under-par 68 to erase her opening round struggles. # Fifa scraps controversial World Cup investment plan

![Image 1: 'Breaking' graphic](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/2048/cpsprodpb/eb7a/live/5c0f70d0-6139-11ee-ac8c-9d18dbc280ea.png)

By Jack Skelton,BBC Sport senior journalist and[Simon Stone](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/topics/c8gr7dqlp5pt),Chief football news reporter

*   Published 1 August 2026 

**Fifa president Gianni Infantino says he has scrapped the controversial plan to sell off stakes in the governing body's major competitions, following widespread opposition.**

Infantino said it had become clear the project had "created divisions" that are "no longer in the interest" of its original objective.

The Swiss added: "As a result, this proposal will not proceed."

Infantino had offered all 211 member associations $40m (£30m) if they backed a proposal for private investment in its tournaments, including the men's and women's World Cups.

More to follow.
